name: Hillside Day Camp
description_short: Village day camp at Hillside Elementary School for children entering 1st to 6th grade, 9 to 3, mixing science experiments, arts and crafts, music and sports, with free swim at Chemka Pool every day and several trips. Non-residents may join if space allows.
notes: Non-resident rates shown: $350 a week or $1,100 full season. Residents of the village or school district pay $300 a week or $850 a season ($275 or $775 early bird in April). The village also runs an Early Learning Camp on a sibling page.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Hillside Day Camp 2026 page: registration from April 1, 2026 in person at the James Harmon Community Center; camp at Hillside Elementary School; residents and school district residents get the resident rate, non-residents may register if space permits at a higher rate; campers bring their own lunch; indoor activities on rainy days. ZIP 10706 is from the Municipal Building address in the page footer (7 Maple Avenue); the page gives no street address for the school.
